query.sql:
WITH 
monthly_counts AS (SELECT
  pg_catalog.date_trunc('month', date::timestamp) AS month,
  pg_catalog.sum(shielded_transactions) AS shielded_transactions,
  pg_catalog.sum(transparent_transactions) AS transparent_transactions,
  pg_catalog.sum(unclassified_transactions) AS unclassified_transactions
FROM analytics_public.activity_daily_query AS activity_daily
WHERE
  date >= '2025-01-01'::date
  AND date < '2026-01-01'::date
GROUP BY
  pg_catalog.date_trunc('month', date::timestamp)),
  rolling_counts AS (SELECT
    month,
    shielded_transactions,
    transparent_transactions,
    unclassified_transactions,
    pg_catalog.avg(shielded_transactions) OVER (
      ORDER BY month
      ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS shielded_3_month_average,
    pg_catalog.lag(shielded_transactions) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS previous_shielded_transactions
  FROM monthly_counts),
  changes AS (SELECT
    month,
    shielded_transactions,
    transparent_transactions,
    unclassified_transactions,
    shielded_3_month_average,
    previous_shielded_transactions,
    shielded_transactions - previous_shielded_transactions AS shielded_monthly_change
  FROM rolling_counts)
SELECT
  month,
  shielded_transactions,
  transparent_transactions,
  unclassified_transactions,
  pg_catalog.round((100.0 * shielded_transactions) / (NULLIF ((shielded_transactions + transparent_transactions) + unclassified_transactions, 0)), 2) AS shielded_share_percent,
  pg_catalog.round(shielded_3_month_average, 2) AS shielded_3_month_average,
  previous_shielded_transactions,
  shielded_monthly_change,
  pg_catalog.abs(shielded_monthly_change) AS absolute_monthly_change
FROM changes
ORDER BY
  month
